what: the night-v4 seat's receipts from the run that reached TRELLIS's mesh stage, transcribed from the night's own ledger and its own log. NOT a night's morning: the run died before it wrote one, so the letter is written from the rows the ledger does hold.

receipts.ledger: artifacts/night-v4/ledger.db on the Thor — the night's own rows: 251 judge.verdict rows, 3 night.heavy_lease rows (each carrying the sweep that ran before it), 18 night.prop_delegate rows, the night's own 240-state decoy-cell probe and its prior fit
receipts.run_log: artifacts/night-v4/run.log on the Thor — the night's log head, and the line it ended on
receipts.measurements: artifacts/night-v4/measurements.json on the Thor — what docs/lab/night-v4-scripts/measure.py reads out of that ledger

status_note: The night itself ran to TRELLIS's mesh stage, where the box's render server stopped answering; its eighteen delegate calls had failed on a picture path, which is now fixed and proved on the crate.

props.note: the night's props were judged — fourteen variants rejected by the critic — but the run died in the mesh stage before a winner was confirmed

decisions.note: the night's own ledger: 251 judge.verdict rows — 245 on the local d1-3B, 4 on Jev, 2 with no author; 181 surfaced, 66 act, 2 escalate

route_probe.note: the night's own 240-state probe, asked on this box's d1-3B at 17:23 — the same numbers as the published §9.4 run (0.5208, act 59, surfaced 181, 46.5 ms)

prior.note: the night's approved set is empty, so the prior is fitted on the measured real objects alone; a group of n cannot score below 0.5/(n+1), so the ghost gate needs ten members in a group and cannot fire on this fit
